RACHID BEHNA

Monsieur Mikhail. Reçu le ticket et la facture pour les 25 [kg] ch./HL 2420 et on fera le règlement.
Reçu la facture pour le 25 7bre 1902, livrées sur bateau et conforme le reconfirmement du marché.
Encore calme, il n’y a pas moyen de trouver places de chemins de fer; partout il faut marcher. [illisible]
J’avais vu les clients de [illisible]; ne voudraient plus retourner les balles qu’ils ont en consignation, et ce sont eux qui profitent.
Je vous prie de m’envoyer une facture: 4/12 [illisible] à 48 [f].
Monsieur Mikhail, il lui a à vendre encore 25 kg ch./HL 2620 à f 18.5.
Veuillez les expédier [illisible] pour ce soir.
[signature]
Translation_to_English:
Rachid Behna

Mister Mikhail. Received the ticket and the invoice for the 25 [kg] ch./HL 2420 and the payment will be made.
Received the invoice for 25 September 1902, delivered by boat and in accordance with the market confirmation.
Still quiet; there is no way to find railway seats; everywhere one must walk. [illegible]
I had seen the clients of [illegible]; they would no longer like to return the bales they have on consignment, and they are the ones who profit.
Please send me an invoice: 4/12 [illegible] at 48 [francs].
Mister Mikhail also has to sell another 25 kg ch./HL 2620 at 18.5 francs.
Please ship them [illegible] for tonight.
[signature]
